content: PostgreSQL official isolation and locking manuals: snapshot reads alone do not protect aggregate capacity; enforce capacity within a serialized per-session mutation boundary, using an engine-appropriate lock, atomic conditional write or serializable transaction with complete retry. This is advisory and does not choose PostgreSQL. Sources https://www.postgresql.org/docs/current/transaction-iso.html and https://www.postgresql.org/docs/current/explicit-locking.html.
